### ToggleChat Beta 3.0.39
> A fresh new update checker and custom toggles!

An update checker has been added to the mod, which will now display a message and button on the main menu when you need to update the mod. Powered by [Apagoge](https://github.com/boomboompower/ApagogeJava). Similarly, the mod's ModernUI has been moved to it's own repo for updates, which can be [found here](https://github.com/boomboompower/ModernUI/). Finally, I've started readding the custom toggle menus as well, currently you can add them, but cannot remove or edit them. This is a huge WIP.

```diff
+ Custom toggles (in beta)
+ Added descriptors to the buttons for the redesigned menu
+ A few toggles for limbo
+ A few toggles for bedwars

~ Added an additional check for the global toggle
~ Fixed the build script due to the forge gradle change!
~ Recoded the custom toggle backend, now uses json instead of a custom format
```

### ToggleChat Beta 3.0.37
> A new design for the mod

For over 4 years the mod has had a single design, I decided to follow advice from [a post in this issue](https://github.com/boomboompower/ToggleChat/issues/20#issuecomment-616205106) where it was suggested to use toggle groups for displaying. As it was impossible to do with the old menu, I decided to rewrite it (since it was clunky anyway). 

The new menu uses vertical scrolling (supports both your mouse wheel and has a scrollbar) which lets you view all the toggles on the screen. If you don't like the new menu, feel free to leave some feedback either on [Github](https://github.com/boomboompower/ToggleChat/issues) or on [my discord](https://discord.boomy.wtf/). Especially if you find bugs.

Here's the changelog:
```diff
+ Added a new design for the mod based on scrolling instead of pagination
+ Added menu for selecting the theme for the mod
+ Added an internal config option to keep track of which design you've chosen (so you don't have to choose each time).

~ Tweaked the names of elements to now be called components
~ Potential fix for favourites in the legacy UI
~ Renamed a few internal IDs, this may reenable some of your disabled toggles, sorry!!!!

- Removed all the custom UI menus (they still load through the config).
```

There are still a few overhauls I'd like to do with the code, such as moving ModernUI and it's other ~~elements~~ components to another github repository, so all my projects can use them from one project and be up to date.

### ToggleChat Beta 3.0.36
> An easier way to search

So after a lot of waiting, I've finally added some basic filtering into the mod, a list of filters can be found here

- All - Displays every toggle
- Chat - Displays all generic chatting toggles, such as global, shouts, teams etc
- Custom - Displays all the custom toggles (yes I know this still isn't done).
- Friends - Displays friend-related toggles such as join/leave messages, private messages, friend requests
- Games - Displays game-specific toggles such as for The Pit, SkyBlock etc
- Guilds - Similar to friends, displays all guild-related toggles.
- Parties - Similar to guilds and friends, displays all party-related toggles.
- QOL (Quality of Life) - Displays generic chat cleaning toggles, such as for separators, adblock, lobby join
- Other - Everything else (mods which add toggles will currently show here).

Additionally I've updated ModernUI to the one SkinChanger is using (yay, callbacks and translations!), so more work on UIs should be a bit easier. There's only one new toggle in this update (which is for SkyBlock) and a revamped Pit toggle. Anyway, here is the changelog.

```diff
+ Added filtering to the main gui
+ Added the "Pit Abilities" toggle

~ Fixed the Pit toggle for users who've prestiged
~ Added "BOUNTY! bump 250g on [XXI-93] User for high streak" to the pit toggle
~ Added "STREAK! of 5 kills by [78] User" to the pit toggle
~ Update ModernUI to the same version SkinChanger uses (3.x?)
~ Added the custom locale handler (nothing translated yet).
~ Moved the "whitelist" button to the position of the custom toggles button
~ Increased the size of the sorting button

- Removed the custom toggle button (the UIs will be redone).
```
